article.story: MIAMI -- — Trey Beamer had 25 points in Florida International's 85-75 win against West Florida on Friday. Beamer shot 8 of 14 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line for the Panthers (2-0). Tijan Saine scored 23 points while going 5 of 10 from the floor, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and 10 for 10 from the line. Noah Mendy shot 3 of 10 from the field, including 2 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line to finish with 12 points. D.J. Shine led the Argonauts (1-1) in scoring, finishing with 27 points and nine rebounds. Alex Godley Jr. added 17 points and seven rebounds.
